name: Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Set the safety stops and sit with your hips supported and the balls of your feet secure on the footplate, heels clear.
Support the sled with your legs nearly straight and keep your knees slightly bent.
Lower your heels gradually until you feel a comfortable calf stretch without losing contact through your forefeet.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels, then lower them under control and secure the sled to finish.
tips: Keep your knees stationary with a very slight bend so your quads do not assist the lift.
Keep your feet securely planted on the bottom edge so they cannot slip off the sled.
